notes: Owner labels. Append moments or clips; do not rewrite old notes. The Pi that recorded these clips was on main 2e64bdb, whose classifier called almost any bowl motion feeding_likely. That pi_label is not ground truth.

moments.label: head_emergence_moist_hide
moments.note: Only her head came out of the moist hide rock. Her body stayed in the hide. This is not the end of a feeding session. Whether a head-only peek is worth keeping is a judgment call, not a required keep.

moments.label: bug_catch
moments.note: She ate a bug. The clip that contains this instant must be kept.

clips.note: Recorded during 21:00-21:02. Do not treat the old feeding_likely label as truth, and do not tune the classifier to call this window feeding. Score the picture.
